# Eventee

Eventee is an intuitive mobile and web app that enhances attendee experience and engagement at in-person, virtual, or hybrid events.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/eventee/.

## Actions

- **Add speaker**: Add a new speaker to a specific eventee event.
- **Delete Speaker**: Delete a speaker by their id.
- **List Events** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all events.
